label: Dr. Joseph Cannon
narrative: Cannon is the named U.S. Government principal investigator on the To The Stars Academy CRADA — the point at which a private company claiming custody of material from a craft of unknown origin was formally connected to an Army laboratory. He is quoted in TTSA's 17 October 2019 announcement: 'Our partnership with TTSA serves as an exciting, non-traditional source for novel materials and transformational technologies.' Army public affairs subsequently distanced the service from the provenance question, with GVSP spokesman Doug Halleaux saying that because 'the Army's interest is in the potential for novel materials and exploring the edges of materials science, any speculation as to their origin is (pardon the pun) immaterial.' When John Greenewald sought Cannon's correspondence with TTSA, the Army located twenty-nine emails totalling one hundred pages and withheld all of them in full under FOIA exemptions (b)(4) and (b)(5).
